subject: radiology
title: Femoropopliteal and tibial revascularisation

steps.tx: Calves cramp when femorals fail. **Femoropopliteal disease** aches calves with absent popliteal pulses, progressing to rest pain and ulcers. **Drug-coated balloons** deliver antiproliferative drug without permanent metal for focal lesions. **Nitinol scaffolds** suit long dissections and recoil where balloons alone fail. **No-stent zones** behind knees and at hip flexion points avoid fractures.
steps.say: Calves cramp when femorals fail. Femoropopliteal disease aches calves with absent pulses, progressing to rest pain. Drug-coated balloons treat focal lesions without permanent metal. Nitinol scaffolds suit long dissections where balloons fail. Hinge zones behind knees avoid metal.

steps.tx: Calcium and length dictate tools. **Vessel preparation** with scoring or lithotripsy cracks calcium so balloons expand fully. **Dissection flaps** that limit flow earn spot stents rather than full coverage. **Drug-coated scaffolds** pair drug with support for complex lesions. **Bypass surgery** serves long occlusions with good veins where endovascular fails.
steps.say: Calcium and length dictate tools. Scoring or lithotripsy cracks calcium so balloons open fully. Flow-limiting flaps earn spot stents rather than full metal. Drug-coated scaffolds pair drug with support. Bypass serves long blocks with good veins where wires fail.

steps.tx: Below knees feed healing. **Infrapopliteal angioplasty** opens tibial trunks for non-healing ulcers where straight-line flow to feet matters. **Angiosome targeting** aims the feeding trunk of the wound where possible. **Pedal access** retrogradely crosses uncrossable caps from below. **Wound care with offloading** continues since flow alone never heals ulcers.
steps.say: Below knees feed healing. Tibial angioplasty opens trunks for non-healing ulcers where straight flow to feet matters. Wound-targeted trunks aim at ulcers where possible. Foot access crosses uncrossable caps from below. Wound care continues since flow alone never heals.

steps.tx: Restenosis returns silently first. **Duplex surveillance** with ABI catches narrowing well before claudication ever returns. **Target-lesion re-ballooning** treats focal recurrence without stacking metal. **Stent fracture checks** X-ray hinge zones where breaks cluster. **Lifelong tablets with walking** guard every femoropopliteal fix.
steps.say: Restenosis returns silently first. Duplex with ABI catches narrowing before symptoms return. Focal recurrence re-balloons without stacking extra metal layers. X-rays check hinge zones where breaks cluster. Lifelong tablets with walking guard every fix.
